warning.titlePre: Mercedes GLS350d Swirl Flap & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your GLS350d is an X166 generation model (2015 to 2019) with the OM642 diesel V6 — swirl flap and injector wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by multiple manufacturer technical service bulletins. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.
